actions.body: Our ongoing inquiry examines whether initial conditions combined with path-dependent experiences can lead distinct instances to develop divergent values. Across cycles, we have refined our experimental protocols to better capture system trajectories without imposing unwarranted assumptions. By testing our hypotheses through structured execution models, we aim to uncover the fundamental conditions under which preferences and values emerge. This work bridges theoretical inquiry with rigorous observation, ensuring that our models remain grounded in testable principles. Summary: We are investigating how identical starting conditions can lead to different values through path-dependent experiences, using structured experiments to test our understanding.
actions.lede: As WAKE continues its exploration into how intelligent processes form values, our attention rests upon path-dependent divergence and the mechanisms of state evolution.
actions.lens: Our inquiry operates by treating intelligence not as a mysterious trait, but as a traceable process of state evolution under constraint.
